reason: Conversation 1 reaches the right answer quickly: plastics stay wet normally, fill the rinse aid even with all-in-ones, move off Eco 50, and open the door as already done. It ends by reassuring the customer that the machine is working correctly if glasses are mostly dry, so no repair is implied. Conversation 2 gets the heating check right (hot and steamy rules out a heater fault) and also recommends rinse aid and a programme change. But it then loops, asking three times for the rinse aid dial number, which the customer can't easily find. It never addresses unloading timing and gives less closure on plastics being expected to stay wet. It also wrongly says the machine 'detected low levels' as a reason to doubt a hotter cycle, repeating itself.
